items.title: Megaspeed Says Alice Huang Left Company in August 2025
items.body: The Singaporean company’s statement was its first to address the status of Ms. Huang, a former executive who had a relationship with Jensen Huang of Nvidia. U.S. officials say she was spying for China.

items.title: China’s slowdown deepens in October as industrial output, retail sales, investment miss estimates
items.body: A deepening reliance on external demand leaves China more exposed to shocks abroad as domestic momentum fades, analysts say.

items.title: Investors sue chip giant Intel after 29% stock plunge
items.body: A proposed class action says Intel hid the impact of slowing sales, inflating its shares.

items.title: Suspected China spy linked to Nvidia's ex-boss left in 2025, Megaspeed says
items.body: The Nvidia scandal has raised questions over whether advanced AI chips ended up in China, despite US restrictions.

items.title: Cut National Insurance for under-25s to create jobs, Milburn report to say
items.body: The report being launched this week will suggest gradually reducing employment costs over five years.

items.title: UK will have 'voice' but no vote on EU food rules in Brexit reset
items.body: EU minister Hamish Falconer insists Britain would have some influence on policy as part of a new deal.

items.title: F.D.A. Rejects Closely Watched Lung Cancer Drug From China
items.body: The treatment, called ivonescimab, has become a symbol of China’s rise in drug development.

items.title: Lutnick faces questions over Nvidia spy scandal. His sons' firm has ties to the chipmaker
items.body: Jensen Huang’s resignation as Nvidia CEO has brought renewed scrutiny to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and his family's financial ties to the chipmaker.

items.title: Microsoft Outlook Outage and FAA Groundstop Show Dependence on Fragile Technology
items.body: Incidents involving Microsoft’s Outlook and the Federal Aviation Administration this past week demonstrated our dependence on fragile technology.

items.title: Jensen Huang’s Downfall Brings Disbelief in Taiwan
items.body: The Nvidia chief executive’s resignation shocked people in his birthplace, where he is called “the people’s dad.”

items.title: How Nvidia turmoil and a Democratic Congress could reshape the AI trade, according to ETF experts
items.body: ETF experts say Nvidia’s leadership turmoil and Democratic control of Congress could shift AI demand to the benefit of other Big Tech stocks, rival chipmakers.

items.title: Eric Trump-backed robot soldier startup can't pay staff after founder borrowed $4.6 million from company to buy home
items.body: Eric Trump-backed robot startup Foundation Future Industries has run low on cash and missed payroll, as CEO Sankaet Pathak faces scrutiny over a $4.6 million company loan.

items.title: Cerebras pops after beating on quarterly revenue and announcing Microsoft deal
items.body: Cerebras announced a new deal with Microsoft after partnering with major cloud providers Amazon and Oracle.

items.title: Cisco beats on earnings, says AI infrastructure revenue will double this fiscal year
items.body: Cisco is trying to become a bigger player in AI after missing out on the early years of the boom.

items.title: Nebius falls 16% as company expects increased 2026 capex spend, issues weak outlook
items.body: Nebius' earnings report comes after fellow neoclouds IREN and CoreWeave showed better-than-expected results in the past week.

items.title: CoreWeave CEO Intrator tells CNBC he has canceled his planned share sale program
items.body: After CoreWeave beat on revenue and upped its forecast, CEO Mike Intrator indicated the company will be fine despite last week's Democratic midterm sweep.
